# World map data

The built-in editable map template uses Natural Earth's 1:110m land polygons, rendered in an equirectangular projection.

Source: https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/blob/master/geojson/ne_110m_land.geojson
Publisher: Natural Earth · https://www.naturalearthdata.com/
Terms: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/

Natural Earth map data is public domain. The local world-land.json retains polygon coordinates and omits feature metadata. Template location markers are illustrative, user-editable markers; they do not represent named real-world locations.
